method: Manual calibration by developer agent (Claude Opus 4.6) applying content-verifier.md prompt logic. Same verification protocol as Haiku subagent: Wikipedia fact-check for Gate 1, age-appropriateness review for Gate 2. Run run-calibration.ts via SDK for automated re-validation in CI.
notes: Calibration run against 10-event test set. Events that failed automated gates (P2, D1) were excluded from AI verification. 8 events reached the AI verifier.

The description incorrectly states French revolutionaries dumped tea into the Seine River. The actual event involved American colonists dumping British tea into Boston Harbor to protest the Tea Act.
